basePrompt: Use case: illustration-story. Create ONE original elementary student sprite for the review window of a children's educational web game. Image 1 is the approved STYLE: match faces' drawing language, thin dark NAVY outlines, soft painted shading, warm storybook palette, scale and hand-drawn finish. Image 2 ONLY hand-drawn texture reference, DO NOT copy its people. Image 3 robot is ONLY fine line weight reference. Images 4/5 show EXISTING cast to AVOID duplicating. This is a NEW clearly distinct student, recognizable from WAIST UP by unique face shape, hair silhouette/shade and top. No orange hoodie/spiky hair combination, no ponytail/green-cream striped girl. Landscape 908x680 pixels, genuine transparent alpha. Exactly TWO full-body copies of ONE student side by side, centered in equal 454px halves. Both naturally standing relaxed, torso and gaze turned slightly toward viewer's RIGHT, complete feet on same bottom baseline, small margin above head. Children approximately FIVE heads tall: head incl hair about one fifth total height, do not make oversized chibi heads; grades 3/4 youthful, grades 5/6 a bit taller older elementary pupils, never adult. LEFT expression: waiting politely and a little shyly for a form to be checked, calm gently uncertain brows, closed mouth or tiny gentle smile, NOT sad/scared/distressed. RIGHT expression: warm happy smile after receiving a good answer. EXACT identical pose, hair, clothing folds, body, hands, size, props, alignment, line weight in both halves; ONLY eyebrows/eyes/mouth expression changes. Most empty-handed; NO forms/papers/books/phones/bags unless subject explicitly specifies. No text, labels, numbers, letters, divider, ground shadow, background or extra people.
